messages:
deploy-bot: ⚠️ Hotfix deploy request: service=embedter, current=3.4.2, target=3.4.3, reason=urgent KVCACHE crash on long sequences. Requesting expedited approvals for surge slot at 23:00 UTC. cc @elaine @raj @tom
elaine: OK, what are rollback criteria and canary plan?
raj: +1 to expedite if rollback runway is clear. We need one-minute tail logs and error rates. If 5xxs > 0.5% for 3m, rollback.
elaine: sounds good. Pin artifact? Provide exact image SHA.
deploy-bot: Artifact pinned: registry.redwood.com/embedter@sha256:3b1f9c7e8a4dff2c8a1d2a4cb9f6e7d8b0c1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5
ana: typo: I'm ana (eng) — I'll run canary checks. I can monitor latency and kv misses.
tom: oncall here. I approve expedited slot provided SRE keeps rollback ready. I'll be near pager.
maria: quick security check — any config changes or new secrets?
ana: no secrets, just runtime fix in kv fetch logic. No schema changes.
elaine: release notes blurb: "hotfix: fix kv cache crash causing 5xx on long prompts; backported to 3.4.x". Keep short.
raj: rollout plan: canary 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> 100% if metrics OK. Auto-rollback on 5xx spike or latency p99 > 500ms above baseline.
elaine: approve canary plan. I sign off for expedited deploy. :white_check_mark:
tom: +1 from oncall. Ready to hit go.
maria: security ack. :shield:
deploy-bot: To deploy, run:
```
redwood deploy --service embedter --image registry.redwood.com/embedter@sha256:3b1f9c7e --canary 5% --canary-duration 10m --track metrics
```
deploy-bot: Rollback command (if needed):
```
redwood rollback --service embedter --to-image registry.redwood.com/embedter@sha256:2f8e7d6c --reason "auto-rollback or manual revert"
```
ana: I'll run smoke tests post-canary: /health, /kv/check, sample-generation.
raj: configuring alert: if embedter_errors_total / requests > 0.005 for 3m -> page SRE.
elaine: Ops sign-off: I authorize expedited surge slot. Publishing brief release note after final.
tom: executing deploy in 2m. I'll call if anything odd.
deploy-bot: Initiating canary rollout now -> 5% targets. Logs: "canary started: embedter v3.4.3 @ sha256:3b1f9c7e"
ana: smoke checks pass (all endpoints green). Latency looks stable.
raj: telemetry: 5xx = 0.00% over last 3m, p99 delta = +12ms. green.
elaine: marking as expedited-approved and adding to release notes draft.
tom: moving to 25% in 5m.
deploy-bot: Canary bump to 25% completed.
ana: quick manual regression tests done. No issues.
raj: metrics steady. I'll stand down but keep an eye.
elaine: good job team. Postmortem only if we see regression.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% started. Final image: registry.redwood.com/embedter@sha256:3b1f9c7e
elaine: closing thread — release note: "Embedter 3.4.3 (hotfix): fixes kv cache crash causing rare 5xxs on long prompts. Deployed 23:07 UTC via expedited surge slot."
deploy-bot: Deployment complete: state=SUCCESS, duration=7m, canary_checks=passed. :tada:
